page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is-4x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs provided by Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server integrates four NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn8is-4x.16xlarge represents a high-density resource profile tailored for workloads that require substantial parallel processing power and large memory capacity without the overhead of local NVMe drives. This configuration is highly suited for deep learning training, large language model inference, high-performance computing, and complex data science pipelines.
